what: Degraded-response insertion point is ambiguous and can fail either side of the existing mv
scenario_or_breakage: If inserted after mv, EXTRACT_TMP no longer exists so RESULT_BYTES is empty; if inserted before mv without restructuring, the later mv can overwrite or race the sentinel
suggested_fix: Restructure the successful jq extraction branch so bytes are measured before publishing, then either write CURSOR_DEGRADED_RESPONSE and skip mv, or mv the extracted result in an explicit else branch

what: Always-on sentinel detection is only planned near the initial OK path and misses retry-success outputs
scenario_or_breakage: A retry launched from an empty first pass can produce CURSOR_DEGRADED_RESPONSE; line 1140 marks the retry file STATUS=OK, and callers without validation-mode still settle on the bad output
suggested_fix: Add a post-retry normalization pass over every STATUS=OK result, or factor a helper and call it both before the initial RESULTS append and before assigning retry STATUS=OK; add a retry-output fixture to Case 5b

what: Length-vs-token heuristic runs before downstream validator short-circuits can protect valid terse sentinels
scenario_or_breakage: A valid short response such as {"no_issues_found": true} with high outputTokens can be rewritten to CURSOR_DEGRADED_RESPONSE before validate-research-output.sh ever sees it
suggested_fix: Whitelist recognized no-findings sentinels in the launcher before applying the degraded heuristic, or narrow the heuristic to known narration-only shapes; add a high-outputTokens no-issues control test
